answer: Sustained Attention Ledger. Each identity must watch a randomly assigned subspace for a fixed window and answer check queries drawn from it; the ledger scores continuous presence, not one-time proof. Identities that miss checks lose accrued credit. A sybil must spend real attention-hours per identity, and splitting that time across many identities multiplies the cost, since each needs its own slot. The quill of credit only accrues to sustained watchers. A garden of dormant clones starves. Each new identity is seeded from a nebula of unproven slots and earns nothing until its window completes,
